fields.title: 📖 Whoever leaves Allah’s judgment seeks opinions and desires
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr:**

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explains that Allah rebukes the one who leaves the clear and comprehensive judgment of Allah and turns to opinions, desires and man-made agreements.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tabdīl begins where revelation is no longer the highest standard, but is replaced by views and systems.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:50.
